operations.title: A smooth four-site mark has a primitive E7 Gysin kernel
operations.body: For a smooth marked hyperplane section S of a quartic double solid, Pic(S)=<H,E1,...,E7>, the Gysin row is intersection with -K=(3,-1^7), namely (3,1^7). It is primitive and surjective; its rank-seven kernel is the negative E7 root lattice of discriminant two.

operations.title: Integral degree-two del Pezzo Gysin audit
operations.body: The checker verifies (-K)^2=2, the primitive Gysin row, an explicit seven-root kernel basis, and kernel Gram determinant two.

operations.title: Benincasa establishes the smooth single-mark E7 extension benchmark
operations.body: Entry 1182: a smooth marked hyperplane in the quartic double solid is degree-two del Pezzo. Its integral Gysin row is primitive (3,1^7), with kernel the negative E7 lattice (rank 7, discriminant 2). Thus the smooth complement benchmark is 0→H3(X)_20→H3(U)_27→E7(-1)→0. Next is the excision square checking that Entry 1181's local node contraction preserves this primitive lattice without index before assembling seven marks.

authority_basis.summary: Record the integral single-mark Gysin benchmark for the smooth quartic double solid.
